answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Each new task hashes the prior verified work; parallel histories are detectably forked. A ocean of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the ledge of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and willow-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
